sections.label: Head
Nose
sections.text:
Watery discharge ; drops into throat. Feels
stopped; pain at root. Dry crusts, on removal, leave
mucous membrane raw. Post-nasal dropping of thick,
bland, yellowish mucus. Crusts in nose.

sections.label: Ears
sections.text:
Catarrhal conjunctivitis and blepharitis margi-
nalis. Eyes feel weak, stiffness of balls and tendency
of lids to close. Feel heayy and droop. Lachrymation
in wind. Agglutination in morning. Dry, painful, burn-
ing; soon tire. (Edema of orbital regiqn. Supraor-
bital pain.

sections.label: Throat
sections.text:
Dark, purplish, swollen, oedematous; red
and glassy.

sections.label: Respiratory
sections.text:
Racking cough, with profuse greenish

expectoration. Oppression of chest and about hearty and
also larynx. Miner’s asthma. Lungs feel as though
smoke had been inhaled.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Aching in arms ; worse in shoulder.
Pain in anterior crural nerves. Joints stiff. Feels tired
all over. Knee-joints crack.
